items.title: Johnny St. Cyr Interview, 1958-08-27
items.q: how do you call them, the bugle? Bugle Sam.

ctx.x: I was going to ask some more when you were just a small boy. I think one night you were talking about the junk dealers and the old bottle rag man with their tin horns. Were you talking about that?
Yeah, they used to play as much on those tin horns as this guy, how do you call them, the bugle? Bugle Sam.
